ex.s: After-school activities also play a part when students apply to college.
ex.t: 当学生申请大学时，课外活动也起到了一定的作用。

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 您还必须惊讶于一种独特的疯狂语言，在这种语言中，房子可以在燃烧时燃烧，您可以通过填写表格来填写表格，并且只有在警报响起时才会听到警报！

ex.s: The Americans and the British also use different words for everyday things.
ex.t: 美国人和英国人对日常事物也使用不同的词汇。

ex.s: Grandfather: (turning to Son) Why don't you also take my advice and think carefully before jumping in with both feet?
ex.t: 爷爷： （转向儿子）你为什么不听我的劝告，仔细想想，然后双脚跳进去？
